_meta.description: FAKE food-themed seed data for AIOS. This is the app's initial assessment for every learner: 5 sections x 4 competences x 3 questions = 60 questions, covering all sections and competences regardless of role (see assessment.service.ts's isInitialAssessment). Everything here is obviously fake. Source links point at a placeholder Moodle base URL (MOODLE_BASE_URL in fakeFoodSeed.ts) built from each source's moodleCourseId -- swap the base URL / ids for real ones later. No SAT instances, responses, scores or recommendations are included, so a freshly logged-in learner starts with all 60 questions unanswered.

questionTypes.multi_choice: content.options[] + correctOptionIds (several), 1 point per correct pick

_meta.everyQuestionAlsoHas: An 'I don't know' choice appended by assessment.pie.ts (IDK_VALUE in assessment.scoring.ts) -- not authored here, added automatically at load time.
